faqs.q: Should I choose Shopify or WooCommerce?
faqs.a: Shopify is usually the simpler choice: hosting, security and checkout are handled for you for a monthly fee. WooCommerce runs on WordPress and gives you more control over hosting and customisation, but needs more upkeep. We recommend one to suit your products, budget and team.

faqs.q: Can customers pay by UPI and Cash on Delivery?
faqs.a: Yes. Razorpay and similar gateways support UPI, cards, net banking and wallets, and Cash on Delivery can be offered with WhatsApp confirmation to reduce fake orders.

faqs.q: Can my store sell to customers in the UAE and Saudi Arabia?
faqs.a: Yes. We can set up multi-currency pricing, international payments and shipping options for GCC customers, either on the same store or a separate one.

faqs.q: Will I be able to manage the store myself?
faqs.a: Yes. You will be able to add products, change prices, run discounts and handle orders, and we include a training session before launch.
